title: Spiced Cherry Pasta with Earthy Mushrooms
description: A unique fusion of Indian and Italian flavors, this spiced cherry pasta dish is made with mildly earthy portuguese portobello mushrooms and sweet cherry tomatoes.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the coconut oil over medium-high heat.
Add the portobello mushrooms and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the garam masala, cumin, coriander, chili flakes, ginger, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cherry tomatoes to the skillet and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Drain the cooked pasta and add it to the skillet with the mushroom and tomato mixture.
Toss the pasta in the skillet to combine with the sauce.
Serve the spiced cherry pasta hot, garnished with chopped cilantro if desired.
Note: This recipe can be made in under 20 minutes, making it a quick and easy dinner option.
